page.title: Aegis Demo — Search vs commit forms

texts.text: DEMO — SYNTHETIC DATA. Every value below is fabricated.

Pressing Enter in a form submits it, so Aegis treats Enter as a commit (L5) by default.
        A search box is the one exception — but only when the whole form has earned it.
        These four cases are what extension/authority has to separate.
1. Plain search form — Enter should be L2
2. Search landmark, no form — Enter should be L2
3. Look-alike form that is not a search — Enter must stay L5
4. Search box sharing a form with a sensitive field — Enter must stay L5
